properties.statement:
"WHAT IS LEFT TO BUILD?" HAS NO ANSWER IN REFLOW2, AND THE REASON IS NARROWER AND WORSE THAN THE REPORT THAT PROMPTED THE CHECK.

ORIGIN: item 1 of the Grok 4.6 agent feedback of 2026-08-13 (`fact:agent-feedback-corroborated-2026-08-14`) — *"'What is left to build?' is not a first-class query. `what_next` ranks open Decisions."* Verified on reflow2's own committed export at `c18a4a1`, 2026-08-14, per `req:agent-authored-feedback-is-reproducible-and-never-leaves-unasked`.

═══ ✅ THEIR CLAIM CONFIRMED ═══

`what_next` (no args) on reflow2's graph returned **12 items: 3 marked + 4 ranked + 1 unexplored + 4 shaping — every one a Decision.** `open_total: 118`, `unranked_pool: 87`. Zero Requirements, zero Capabilities. Its own description says so honestly (*"which decisions to settle next"*), so this is a scope fact rather than a bug. `arrival_delta` requires a DesignEpoch or Release `target_id`, so it cannot answer for a design whose remaining work is not scheduled onto one.

THE HONEST ANSWER, computed directly from the export:
```
Requirements 164   accepted 115  proposed 36  dropped 9  deferred 4
Capabilities 161   verified 77  realized 41  planned 40  in_progress 3
accepted + live + NOT delivered ............ 9
live planned/in_progress capabilities ..... 43
```
**None of those 43 appears in any tool's answer to "what next".**

═══ 🛑🛑 THE MECHANISM, AND IT IS THE REAL FINDING ═══

`unrealized_capability` LOOKS like the build list — *"Nothing builds capability X"* — but fires only 3 times against 43 planned capabilities. `detect.rs` suppresses it three ways, and the decisive one is **`realized_via_component`**:

```rust
fn realized_via_component(&self, cap_id) -> bool {
    for alloc in outgoing(cap_id, ALLOCATED_TO) {
        if !incoming(alloc.to_id, REALIZES).is_empty() { return true }
    }
    false
}
```

⭐ **IT ASKS WHETHER THE COMPONENT HAS ANY ARTIFACT — NOT WHETHER THE CAPABILITY DOES.** Measured over the 39 live planned capabilities holding no artifact of their own:
```
suppressed by realized_via_component ....... 34   <-- the guard
suppressed by owner_claims_built ...........  2
would actually raise the gap ...............  5
```
⇒ **IN A MATURE PROJECT EVERY COMPONENT ALREADY HAS CODE, SO EVERY NEW PLANNED CAPABILITY IS BORN PRE-SUPPRESSED.** The four captured earlier the same day prove it: `cap:init-asks-which-harness` → `cmp:packaging` (1 artifact), `cap:nudge-absence-says-why` → `cmp:packaging` + `cmp:service` (6), `cap:decomposition-coverage-is-asked` → `cmp:detect` (1), `cap:the-design-interview-precedes-the-capture` → `cmp:skills` (2). All four are `planned`, none has an artifact, **and reflow2 will never ask what gets built for any of them.**

⚠️ THE SUPPRESSION IS DELIBERATE AND WELL-ARGUED, WHICH IS WHY THIS IS A DESIGN QUESTION RATHER THAN A BUG. The BL-42 comment in `detect.rs` records the reasoning: a storyflow adopt trial produced *"13 of 51 gaps, every one produced by following the adopt skill's own instruction to model artifacts coarsely over a system that is entirely built"*, and its stated bargain is *"the question is dropped and the number is kept (`realization` in `graph_report`)"*. **The guard solves the brownfield-adopt noise problem and creates the greenfield-increment blindness problem, and nothing recorded the second half.**

═══ ⚠️ A WRONG FIRST DIAGNOSIS, KEPT ON THE RECORD ═══

This session first blamed `owner_claims_built` — the guard that skips a capability whose owning Component is marked `realized`. **Measurement refuted it: only 2 of 39, and the four components involved are all `planned`, not `realized`.** The correct guard was found only by reading `realized_via_component` and counting. Recorded because the same failure — asserting a mechanism from a plausible description instead of measuring it — is the one `dec:idea-intent-crosses-designs` already documents twice about this project.

═══ 📌 WHAT WAS NOT CHECKED ═══

The computation predicts **5** capabilities would raise the gap; the gate reported **3** *"Nothing builds capability"* notes. The 2-item discrepancy was NOT run down — likely `is_discontinued` handling or scope filtering differing from the approximation used here (OBSOLETES targets). **The direction and magnitude of the finding do not depend on it, but the exact figure should not be quoted as though it were reconciled.** Also unchecked: whether `graph_report`'s `realization` number — the half of BL-42's bargain that was kept — is actually reachable by an agent asking what to build next.
